reuse.why: Puts the check in accounts/link.ts beside the existing findOrCreateBank, types it with the existing AccountSyncSource, and applies it to every provider handler through one wrapper.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once and the guard is wired once at registration; only the provider literal and account-id accessor are stated per handler, which is the real variation.

placement.why: The link rule lives in link.ts, the module for bank-link helpers, and the guard is composed at app.method registration, leaving the provider link functions untouched.

scope.why: Only the check, the registration wrapper and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Clear, tested single definition; the guard sits at registration, so a direct internal call to a link function would skip it and a new provider must remember to wrap its handler.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, applied to all five *-accounts-link handlers via guardBankAccountLink in accounts/app.ts
